Index.title: Play Dots Online
Index.subtitle: The classic territorial strategy game. Enclose your opponent's dots to capture them. Play with friends instantly—no sign up required.
Index.objectiveText: The goal of the game is to capture more dots than your opponent. You capture enemy dots by surrounding them with a continuous, closed line of your own dots.
Index.placementText: Players take turns placing a single dot on an empty intersection of the grid lines. You can place a dot anywhere on the board.
Index.capturingText: To capture, you must form a closed polygon (a loop) of your dots that completely encloses at least one enemy dot. The loop cannot contain only empty spaces—it must surround at least one opponent's dot to be valid. Once captured, those enemy dots belong to you.
Index.winningText: The game ends when the board is completely full, no more valid moves can be made, or both players agree to stop. The player who has captured the most enemy dots wins the match.
Index.faq1Q: Can I play on my mobile phone?
Index.faq1A: Yes! The game is fully responsive and supports touch controls. You can use 'Direct Touch' or 'Drag & Release' in the settings for better precision on smaller screens.
Index.faq2A: Absolutely. The game is 100% free with no hidden fees or microtransactions.
Index.faq3Q: Do I need to register an account?
Index.faq3A: No registration is required. You can instantly create a room and share the link with your friend to start playing immediately.
Index.faq4A: You have the option to enable a timer when creating a room (e.g., 5 minutes per player with a 3-second increment per move), just like in chess.
